hotels.vendor_name: Sofitel Montreal Le Carré Doré / Golden Mile
hotels.title: Sophisticated Montreal Downtown French-Inspired Luxury with Onsite Restaurant & Cocktail Lounge
hotels.description: Zhuzh up your Canadian escape with a dash of French flair at this five-star Sofitel sanctuary perfectly positioned at the foot of Mount Royal in downtown Montreal’s fashionable Golden Mile. Unwind in chic, light-filled rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and glittering city views, while enjoying top-tier amenities and world-class hospitality. Savour gourmet French cuisine with a local twist at Renoir Restaurant, then sip handcrafted cocktails at the stylish NINI Salon à Cocktails. Step outside to explore the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts or the upscale boutiques along Sainte-Catherine Street. With the metro moments away, reaching Old Montreal and the iconic Notre-Dame Basilica is a breeze.
